fact: Senegal's government adopted the implementing decree for Startup Law No. 2020-01 of 6 January 2020, setting criteria (one-third Senegalese capital) and incentives.

APS reports the startup law was adopted 'in January last', granting three years of tax exemption and easing access to finance and public procurement, with its implementing decree and the Ecosysteme Startup platform launched on 20 November 2025.
President Faye's speech commits to updating and operationalising Senegal's existing Startup Act, including labelling and an incentive framework.
Prime Minister Ousmane Sonko highlighted the implementation of the Startup Act and support measures for tech entrepreneurs.
